title: Pancreatic involvement in lung cancer: Imaging findings and diagnostic challenges in two cases

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Pancreatic involvement in lung cancer: Imaging findings and diagnostic challenges in two cases》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Pancreatic metastases from lung cancer are uncommon and may be difficult to distinguish from primary pancreatic malignancies.

evidence.text: Pancreatic metastases from lung cancer are uncommon and may be difficult to distinguish from primary pancreatic malignancies.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Pancreatic involvement in lung cancer: Imaging findings and diagnostic challenges in two cases》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】We report 2 patients with lung cancer and pancreatic lesions causing biliary obstruction.

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】The first patient was a 58-year-old man with small-cell lung carcinoma and a pancreatic head mass associated with biliary and pancreatic duct dilatation and extensive vascular contact.

evidence.text: We report 2 patients with lung cancer and pancreatic lesions causing biliary obstruction.
The first patient was a 58-year-old man with small-cell lung carcinoma and a pancreatic head mass associated with biliary and pancreatic duct dilatation and extensive vascular contact.
